Water splitting aur oxygen release connected events hain; inka detailed mechanism aage kholenge.
ATP aur NADPH kyun banane hain?
Dekho, ATP usable energy aur NADPH reducing power supply karta hai, isliye captured light baad ki sugar synthesis ke kaam aa sakti hai.
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast cutaway mein thylakoid membrane highlighted; paas chaar simple event tiles: light absorption, water splitting, O₂ release, ATP + NADPH formation.

says: Yeh events several protein complexes ki madad se chalte hain; complex mein molecules ek organised working group banate hain.
Photosystem light collect karne aur photochemical event shuru karne wali pigment–protein unit hai.
Do distinct units hain: Photosystem I, ya PS I, aur Photosystem II, ya PS II.
Inmein light harvesting complexes pigments aur proteins ki light-collecting teams hain.
Kya PS I ka naam functioning mein pehle aane ka proof hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki PS I pehle function karta hai, par asal mein I aur II discovery ka order batate hain, functioning ka nahi.
Actual electron route ko hum agle heading mein dekhenge.
points.screen: Usi thylakoid membrane ka molecular zoom: do separate pigment–protein units PS I aur PS II, dono mein light harvesting complex region highlighted; discovery-order tag dono names se linked.

terms.meaning: Light collect karke photochemical electron transfer shuru karne wali organised pigment–protein unit.
Photosystems mein light collect karne wale protein-bound pigments ke groups.

points.outside_book: Protein complex ko organised molecular working group ke roop mein briefly clarify kiya.

says: Ek light harvesting complex mein hundreds of pigment molecules proteins se bound hote hain.
Photosystem ke collecting pigments milkar antennae banate hain, yaani light-harvesting pigment network.
Is collecting network se special reaction-centre chlorophyll a ko alag pehchaano; reaction centre woh site hai jahaan excitation electron transfer shuru karati hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki chlorophyll a sirf reaction centre mein hota hai, par asal mein antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ke saath doosre pigments hote hain.
Itne pigments saath hone se efficiency kyun badhti hai?
Dekho, different pigments different wavelengths capture karte hain, aur pehle samjha accessory-pigment energy transfer us collection ko reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
points.screen: Ek photosystem ka wahi molecular view: protein scaffold par many antenna pigments; unse alag reaction-centre chlorophyll a site; selected coloured light beams collecting pigments tak.

terms.meaning: Photosystem ka protein-bound pigment network jo light collect karke excitation energy reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
Photosystem ki special chlorophyll a site jahaan excitation se electron donation shuru hota hai.

points.outside_book: Reaction centre ka functional meaning figure se pehle khola; antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ki presence clarify ki.

says: Socho, chhat par ek badi collector dish weak incoming signal ko apni broad surface se collect karti hai.
Dish ka arrangement signal ko ek focal detector tak concentrate karta hai, jahaan useful electrical response shuru hota hai.
Badi collecting surface aur chhota detector alag jobs kyun kar rahe hain?
Dekho, broad collector signal pakadne ka chance badhata hai, jabki detector collected signal ko agle useful event mein badalta hai.
Yahaan dish antenna pigments ka network hai, focal detector reaction centre hai, aur signal ka focus hona excitation energy ka reaction centre tak pahunchna hai.
points.screen: Collector dish se focal detector tak converging signal paths; saath photosystem ke antenna se reaction centre tak matching energy paths.
points.outside_book: Collector dish aur focal detector ka everyday analogy add kiya.
points.answer: Dish antenna pigment network ko, focal detector reaction centre ko, aur converging signal excitation-energy transfer ko represent karta hai.
points.watch_out: Pigments actual dish ki tarah light reflect karke focus nahi karte; absorbed excitation energy molecular interactions se transfer hoti hai.

says: Figure 11.4, light harvesting complex, mein Photon label se shuru karo: photon light energy ka ek packet hai, jo peripheral pigment par aata hai.
Pigment molecules label collecting cluster ko identify karta hai.
Red zigzag route absorbed excitation energy ko pigments ke through Reaction centre tak jaate dikhata hai.
Excitation energy ka matlab light absorption se mili extra energy hai.
Reaction centre se upward blue arrow Primary acceptor tak electron donation dikhata hai; primary acceptor reaction centre ka electron sabse pehle leta hai.
Kya zigzag aur blue arrow ek hi cheez ka transfer dikhate hain?
Dekho, zigzag antenna mein excitation-energy transfer hai, jabki blue arrow reaction centre se acceptor ko electron transfer hai.
Electron donation se donor aur acceptor par alag charges bante hain; is charge separation se light capture ek chemical event se judta hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.4 ke labels Photon, Pigment molecules, Reaction centre, Primary acceptor sequentially highlighted; red excitation route aur blue electron arrow distinctly traced.

terms.meaning: Light energy ka ek packet.
Light absorb hone par pigment ko mili extra energy.
Reaction centre se donate hua electron sabse pehle receive karne wala molecule.
Electron transfer ke baad donor aur acceptor par alag electrical charges ka banna.

points.outside_book: Photon, excitation energy aur charge separation ke basic meanings electron-transfer figure samajhne ke liye add kiye.

says: Ab isi complex mein chlorophyll b ke ek peripheral molecule par absorbed photon follow karo.
Us absorption ki excitation energy antenna network ke through special chlorophyll a reaction centre tak pahunchti hai.
Uske baad acceptor ko electron kaun deta hai?
Dekho, reaction-centre chlorophyll a electron donate karta hai; peripheral chlorophyll b ki role yahaan energy collect karke centre tak pahunchane ki thi.
Is ek event mein photon ki energy ka contribution aur reaction centre se nikle electron ka route alag pehchaan mein aa gaya.
points.screen: Wahi photosystem view: ek chlorophyll b molecule highlighted; energy pulse network se centre tak, phir alag electron marker centre se acceptor tak.
points.outside_book: Figure ke generic peripheral pigment ko chlorophyll b maan kar ek concrete worked event follow kiya.

says: Dono photosystems ke special reaction centres ko ab unki characteristic absorption wavelengths se pehchaanenge.
Absorption peak woh wavelength hai jahaan absorption maximum hota hai; nm ki unit hum pehle khol chuke hain.
PS I ka centre 700 nm peak ke kaaran P700, aur PS II ka centre 680 nm maximum ke kaaran P680 kehlaata hai.
Kya alag peak names ka matlab alag pigment types hain?
Aksar log sochte hain ki P700 aur P680 alag pigment types hain, par asal mein dono special chlorophyll a centres hain.
Dekho, in names ke numbers characteristic peak wavelengths batate hain, pigment molecules ki count nahi.
points.screen: Usi membrane view ke PS I aur PS II centres par labels: PS I—chlorophyll a—P700—700 nm; PS II—chlorophyll a—P680—680 nm.

points.answer: Antenna light capture karta hai, lekin functional reaction-centre chlorophyll a photochemical electron donation shuru karta hai; collection akeli us missing function ko replace nahi karti.
points.watch_out: Chlorophyll b ki abundance ko reaction-centre chlorophyll a ka replacement samajhna galat hai; collection aur photochemical conversion alag jobs hain.

says: Ab local sequence phir jodo: pehle antenna pigment photon absorb karta hai, phir excitation energy network se reaction centre tak pahunchti hai.
Reaction-centre chlorophyll a electron primary acceptor ko deta hai; energy transfer aur electron transfer ko alag rakho.
PS I ka centre P700 aur PS II ka P680 hai; I aur II discovery-order names hain.
Poore light phase ka result kis kaam se judega?

says: Ab reaction centre se nikle electron ka raasta follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki do light boosts use NADPH formation tak kaise pahunchate hain.

Yahaan teen padaav hain: PS II mein excitation, carriers se PS I tak transfer aur doosri excitation, phir final acceptor ki reduction.
Ek route mein light do baar kyun chahiye?
Dekho, beech ke transfers mein electron ki available energy ghatati hai, isliye aage reducing power banane ke liye PS I doosra boost deta hai.

says: Raasta PS II ke P680 reaction centre se shuru karo, jise hum special chlorophyll a site pehchaan chuke hain.
680 nm red light absorb hone par electron excited hota hai, yaani higher-energy state mein pahunchta hai.
Isse nucleus se farther orbit mein jump ki simple picture se samajh sakte ho; molecular level par important baat higher-energy state hai.
Electron acceptor woh molecule hai jo doosre molecule se electron receive karta hai; yahaan pehla receiver primary acceptor hai.
Excited electron ka agla stop kya hai?
Dekho, acceptor electron receive karke use aage electron transport system ko hand over karta hai.
points.screen: Ussi thylakoid cutaway mein P680 par 680 nm light; paas ke energy inset mein electron higher level par jaakar PS II acceptor tak pahunchta hai.

Redox potential electron lene ya dene ki tendency ka measure hai; oxidation aur reduction ko hum electron transfer se jod chuke hain.
Chain mein transfer energetically downhill hai, yaani electron ki available energy ka kuch hissa release hota hai.

Kya pehla ramp paar karte hi trolley gayab ho gayi?

Ek NADPH banane ka electron ledger hai: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.

Dekho, Z electron-transfer energetics ka representation hai, membrane mein bana literal zigzag raasta nahi.

says: Ab ek marked electron token ko P680 se follow karo: light excitation ke baad woh PS II acceptor, phir carriers aur PS I tak pahunchta hai.

Do electrons aur ek proton se ek NADPH banta hai; carriers mein electrons destroy nahi hote.
Do light boosts aur downhill transfers Z scheme ki profile dete hain, aur ATP formation ki branch bhi is transport se judi hai.

parts.goal: Ab PS II ki replacement supply ko water splitting se jodenge, aur electrons, oxygen aur protons ka hisaab unki sahi location par rakhenge.

says: Ab PS II ki replacement supply ko water splitting se jodenge, aur electrons, oxygen aur protons ka hisaab unki sahi location par rakhenge.
Humne dekha tha ki PS II se electron transport chain PS I ko replacement electrons pahunchati hai.
Lekin PS II khud continuously electrons kaise supply karega?
Dekho, PS II ke donated electrons ki replacement water splitting se milti hai, isliye uski supply sirf pehle se maujood electrons par nahi tikti.

points.screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane cutaway mein PS II se carriers aur PS I tak pehle se jaana electron route faint rahe; PS II ke paas water input highlight ho.

says: Splitting of water woh process hai jisme water se electrons, H⁺ aur oxygen milte hain; yeh PS II se associated hai.
Is process ko photolysis bhi kehte hain: photo light ko aur lysis splitting ko batata hai.
Water ke electrons PS II ki electron kami poori karte hain, aur PS II transport chain ke through PS I ki kami poori karta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki water splitting PS I ko directly refill karti hai, par asal mein yahaan replacement route pehle PS II se guzarta hai.
Oxygen photosynthesis ke net products mein hai; net products poori process ka overall hisaab karne ke baad milne wale substances hain.

terms.meaning: PS II-associated process jisme water se electrons, H⁺ aur oxygen milte hain.

Yahaan supply box water hai, pehla worker PS II hai, beech ki line electron carriers hain, aur doosra worker PS I hai.

Do H₂O mein total chaar hydrogen atoms aur do oxygen atoms hain.

Isliye har ek O₂ ke saath do waters ki oxidation se chaar replacement electrons aur chaar H⁺ milte hain.
Water electrons deta hai, isliye yeh water ki oxidation hai; light-driven machinery is electron extraction ko possible banati hai.

points.outside_book: Equation ka explicit charge balance aur water oxidation se sambandh samjhaya gaya hai.

Thylakoid sacs ko hum grana ke building units pehchaan chuke hain; membrane se ghiri unki andar ki jagah lumen hai.
Bahar surrounding fluid stroma hai, jise hum pehle locate kar chuke hain.

Thylakoid membrane se ghiri andar ki jagah.

says: Poora connection jodo: PS II electron donate karta hai, aur lumen-facing water-splitting complex uski replacement supply deta hai.

Electrons PS II ko milte hain, phir transport chain PS I ki replacement karti hai.
H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release hote hain; O₂ baad mein bahar diffuse kar sakti hai.
Water yahaan electron source hai, jabki photosystems ki excitation ko energy light deti hai.
points.screen: Ussi completed local membrane picture mein teen quiet routes: electrons → PS II → PS I; H⁺ → lumen; O₂ → outward diffusion. Neeche balanced equation rahe.

says: Ab electron ke aage jaane aur PS I par lautne ke routes ko compare karke samjhenge ki light se ATP formation ke saath kaunse products milte hain.

Yahaan bakery stromal biosynthesis hai, delivery light reactions ki supply hai, aur bacha stock available ATP aur NADPH hai.
Light lautne se supply renew hona van ki delivery dobara shuru hone jaisa hai.
points.screen: Bakery mein limited ingredient trays aur charged packs se do remaining batches; neeche matching chloroplast timeline mein available ATP/NADPH ghatte hue, phir supply restart.
points.outside_book: Limited-stock bakery analogy indirect dependence samjhane ke liye added hai.
points.answer: Bakery = stromal biosynthesis; delivery = light-reaction supply; remaining stock = available ATP aur NADPH; delivery restart = illumination se renewed supply.
points.watch_out: ATP aur NADPH ko long-term stored reserves ya bakery ingredients ke chemically identical equivalents na samjhein.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: kya biosynthetic phase ko dark reaction kehna misleading naam, ya misnomer, ho sakta hai?
Light-off timeline ko reason banao; kya darkness ne synthesis ko start kiya tha?
Dekho, darkness is phase ki requirement nahi hai, aur light-reaction supplies khatam hone par yeh rukta hai, isliye dark naam night-only process ka galat impression deta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki light reactions din mein aur dark reactions sirf raat mein chalti hain, par asal mein yeh directly aur indirectly light-dependent kaamon ka distinction hai.
points.screen: Light-off timeline par brief continuation aur later stop highlighted; uske saamne label: directly light-driven nahi, light-reaction products par dependent.
points.answer: Dark naam misleading hai kyunki darkness required nahi; ATP aur NADPH ki renewed supply ke liye biosynthesis indirectly light reactions par depend karti hai.
points.watch_out: Brief continuation ko unlimited darkness mein synthesis ka proof na samjhein; remaining supplies limited hain.

says: Ab ATP aur NADPH ka detailed use samajhne ke liye overall sugar formation ke andar carbon ka raasta dhoondhenge.
Humne CO₂ aur H₂O se carbohydrate formation ka overall account dekha tha; ab wahi carbohydrate composition (CH₂O)ₙ se likh sakte hain.
Is notation mein n batata hai ki CH₂O ka composition ratio kitni baar liya gaya; glucose ke liye n six hai.
Kya overall equation bata deti hai ki incoming carbon sabse pehle kis compound mein gaya?
Dekho, overall equation manzil batati hai, isliye scientists ne first product, yaani CO₂ fix hone ke baad sabse pehle pehchaane jaane wale compound, ki khoj ki.
Fixation ka pehle khola meaning yaad rakho: CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule ka hissa banana.
points.screen: Stroma mein CO₂ + H₂O se (CH₂O)ₙ ki overall arrow; arrow ke beech pehla unknown product-box khulta hai. Side par (CH₂O)₆ → C₆H₁₂O₆.

terms.meaning: Carbohydrate composition ka general notation; n CH₂O ratio ki repetitions batata hai.
CO₂ fixation ke baad shuru mein pehchaana gaya reaction product.

says: Calvin aur Bassham ki labelled carbon wali khoj hum pehle mil chuke hain; ab us investigation ka specific result dekho.
World War II ke baad radioactive isotopes, ya radioisotopes, ka beneficial use karte hue Calvin ne algae mein photosynthesis investigate ki.
Pehle khola radioactive ¹⁴C yahaan carbon ki pehchaan tha; early products mein uska signal incoming carbon ka destination batata tha.
Un studies mein pehla identified CO₂ fixation product three-carbon organic acid, 3-phosphoglyceric acid, mila; iska short name PGA hai.
Final sugar se pehle acid milna important kyun tha?
Dekho, isse pata chala ki fixed carbon seedha final glucose ke roop mein identify nahi hua, balki beech ke product PGA mein mila.
Calvin aur co-workers ne complete biosynthetic pathway bhi work out kiya; unke naam par ise Calvin cycle kaha gaya.
points.screen: Algal culture ko ¹⁴CO₂ input; early separated product mein labelled PGA highlighted. PGA ke teen carbon positions aur neeche pathway name Calvin cycle; abhi detailed cycle steps nahi.

terms.meaning: Elements ke radioactive isotopes, jinhe detectable tracing labels ki tarah use kar sakte hain.
Carbon ka radioactive isotope jiska mass number 14 hai; pehle C¹⁴ notation mein pehchaana tha.
3-phosphoglyceric acid; teen carbon wala organic acid aur identified early fixation product.
Calvin ke naam par jaana jaane wala photosynthetic carbon-assimilation ka biosynthetic pathway.

says: Ab batao, PGA ke ek molecule mein kitne carbon atoms hain?
Dekho, PGA mein teen carbon atoms hain; tracer ka 14 carbon isotope ka mass number hai, PGA ke carbon atoms ki count nahi.
Ek PGA molecule mein labelled carbon milne se uska poora skeleton fourteen-carbon wala nahi ban jaata.
points.screen: Ek PGA carbon skeleton par teen numbered carbon positions; ek position par ¹⁴C tag. Separate labels: molecule carbon count = 3; tracer mass number = 14.
points.outside_book: Tracer mass number aur product carbon-count ka explicit distinction added hai.
points.answer: PGA ke ek molecule mein teen carbon atoms hote hain.
points.watch_out: ¹⁴C ka 14 isotope mass number hai, molecule mein carbon atoms ki sankhya nahi.

says: Agla sawaal tha: kya har plant mein initial CO₂ fixation ka pehla stable product PGA hi hota hai?
Wide plant surveys mein doosra group mila, jiska first stable product four-carbon organic acid oxaloacetic acid tha.
First stable product fixation ke baad pehla stable compound hai, sirf overall final sugar nahi.
CO₂ fixation ka meaning wahi organic molecule mein carbon jodna hai; CO₂ assimilation ka broader meaning us carbon ko plant ke organic substances mein incorporate karna hai.
Jin plants ka initial stable product three-carbon PGA hai, unka initial route C₃ pathway kehlaata hai.
Jinmein four-carbon oxaloacetic acid pehla stable product hai, unka initial route C₄ pathway kehlaata hai.
In names ke three aur four kya ginte hain?
Dekho, yeh first stable product ke carbon atoms ginte hain, incoming CO₂ molecules ya carbon lene wale starting molecule ke carbons nahi; associated differences aage dekhenge.
points.screen: Survey ka simple two-branch comparison: C₃ → PGA → 3 carbon positions; C₄ → oxaloacetic acid → 4 carbon positions. Column heading: initial first stable fixation product.

terms.meaning: CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule mein jodna; pehle fixing CO₂ ke roop mein samjha tha.
CO₂ ke carbon ko plant ke organic substances ka hissa banana.
Four-carbon organic acid; C₄ route ka initial first stable fixation product.
Initial fixation ke baad milne wala pehla stable compound.

points.watch_out: First stable product ko carbon receive karne wale starting molecule se confuse na karein.

says: Ab poora connection jodo: light reactions ki O₂ bahar diffuse hoti hai, aur ATP tatha NADPH stromal sugar synthesis ko support karte hain.
Light band hone par remaining supplies se brief continuation milti hai, phir stop; light lautne par renewed supply se synthesis resume hoti hai.
Carbon ka raasta dhoondhne par algal tracer studies mein three-carbon PGA pehla identified product mila.
Wider surveys ne four-carbon oxaloacetic acid wala initial route bhi dikhaya, isliye first stable product se C₃ aur C₄ classification bani.
Lekin incoming CO₂ ko sabse pehle receive kaun karta hai?
Dekho, product ki identity mil gayi hai; use banane wale primary CO₂ acceptor ki identity agle heading mein dekhenge.
points.screen: Teen connected compact panels: light supplies → stromal synthesis; on/off/on response; PGA–3C versus oxaloacetic acid–4C. Last panel se agle sawaal ki taraf arrow: CO₂ ko receive kaun karta hai?

parts.bridge: Pehla product PGA pehchaan liya; ab primary CO₂ acceptor khojkar samjhenge ki incoming carbon us product tak kaise pahunchta hai.
parts.title: WHERE ARE THE ATP AND NADPH USED?

parts.goal: Ab PGA ki pehchaan se aage badhkar CO₂ lene wala starting molecule khojenge, aur uske carbon count ko product ke carbon count se jodenge.

says: Ab PGA ki pehchaan se aage badhkar CO₂ lene wala starting molecule khojenge, aur uske carbon count ko product ke carbon count se jodenge.
Yahaan incoming CO₂ jis starting molecule se judta hai, use khojna hai; electron receive karne wala primary acceptor isse alag hai.
PGA mein teen carbon atoms hain, jaisa hum abhi pehchaan chuke hain.
Scientists ka sawaal bhi yahi tha: ek-carbon CO₂ judne ke baad three-carbon PGA mile, toh starting molecule mein kitne carbons honge?
Teen mein se ek ghataakar two-carbon starting molecule sochna natural hai, lekin kya product ke sirf ek molecule ko ginana kaafi hai?
Dekho, starting molecule ka carbon count nikaalne ke liye product molecules ki total count bhi chahiye, isliye sirf subtraction se identity decide nahi hogi.
points.screen: Chloroplast ke stromal region par CO₂ ka one-carbon model aur ek three-carbon PGA model; starting molecule ki jagah question mark, saath product molecules ki count ke liye khaali boxes.
points.answer: Ek PGA ke three carbons se starting molecule ka size decide nahi hota; total product molecules bhi ginne honge.
points.watch_out: 3 − 1 = 2 tabhi valid inference hota jab ek starting molecule aur ek CO₂ se sirf ek PGA banta.

says: Experiments ka unexpected answer five-carbon ketose sugar ribulose bisphosphate, ya RuBP, tha.
Incoming CO₂ isi starting sugar molecule se judta hai.
RuBP mein five-carbon skeleton aur do alag positions par phosphate groups hote hain; bisphosphate naam in do phosphate groups ko batata hai.
Ketose sugar ka matlab aisa sugar hai jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.
Ketone group mein ek carbon oxygen se double bond banata hai aur dono taraf carbon se juda hota hai.
Five-carbon starting molecule se three-carbon product kaise milega?
Dekho, carbon conservation sahi rehti hai; humein reaction ke saare product molecules ka hisaab jodna hoga.
points.screen: Usi stromal picture mein RuBP ka five-carbon molecular model; terminal positions par do phosphate tags aur open-chain structure mein internal C=O highlight.

terms.meaning: Five-carbon sugar jiske do alag positions par phosphate groups lage hote hain; incoming CO₂ isse judta hai.
Sugar jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.

points.outside_book: Ketone group ki basic bonding aur bisphosphate naam ke parts ki explanation clarity ke liye jodi gayi hai.

says: Agar tumne two-carbon acceptor guess kiya, toh ghabraao mat; scientists ne bhi pehle yahi possibility sochi thi.
Unhone many years ek 2-carbon compound, yaani do carbon atoms wale compound, ko acceptor ke roop mein dhoondhne mein lagaaye.
Bahut experiments ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki identity mili.
Galat guess itna convincing kyun laga?
Aksar log sochte hain ki three-carbon PGA milne par starting acceptor two-carbon hi hoga, par asal mein ek product molecule ka size poore reaction ka carbon total nahi hota.
Dekho, saare product molecules ginne par five-carbon RuBP ka hisaab milta hai.
points.screen: Research timeline: three-carbon PGA se two-carbon acceptor ka initial hypothesis; multiple experimental observations ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki confirmed identity.

terms.meaning: Aisa compound jiske ek molecule mein do carbon atoms hon.

says: Ab ek RuBP molecule ke five carbon counters lo, aur incoming CO₂ ka ek carbon counter unke saath jodo.
Balanced equations mein atoms conserve hote hain, jaisa hum overall photosynthesis equation mein dekh chuke hain.
Total six carbons ko do three-carbon groups mein baanto; har group ek PGA molecule ka carbon skeleton dikhata hai.
Carbon ledger hua: 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
Kya six-carbon total ka matlab ek stable six-carbon product hi milega?
Dekho, total carbon count six hai, lekin stable products do PGA molecules hain; ek molecule ka size aur saare products ka total alag quantities hain.
points.screen: Pehle wale RuBP model ke five carbon counters mein ek labelled CO₂ carbon judta hai; wahi six counters do PGA groups mein bantte hain, neeche 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
points.outside_book: Do PGA molecules ka carbon ledger agle heading ki reaction ko samajhne ke liye yahaan briefly khola gaya hai.

says: Socho, packing table par five toy blocks pehle se rakhe hain aur courier ek aur block laata hai.
Worker six blocks ko do parcels mein pack karta hai, har parcel mein three blocks.
Tum sirf ek parcel kholkar bolo ki three blocks mein se one naya tha, isliye table par pehle sirf two blocks honge.
Yeh conclusion kyun galat hoga?
Dekho, doosre parcel ke three blocks bhi same starting collection se aaye hain, isliye poori shipment ginne par starting five blocks ka hisaab milta hai.
Yahaan starting five blocks RuBP ke carbons hain, naya block CO₂ ka carbon hai, aur two parcels do PGA molecules hain.
points.screen: Packing table ke five toy blocks, ek arriving block, phir do three-block parcels; unke neeche corresponding RuBP, CO₂ aur two PGA carbon groups.
points.outside_book: Parcel analogy carbon conservation aur product count ka distinction samjhaati hai.
points.answer: Five starting blocks = RuBP ke five carbons; incoming block = CO₂ ka carbon; two three-block parcels = do PGA molecules.
points.watch_out: Toy blocks unchanged objects hain; actual reaction mein atoms ke chemical bonds rearrange hote hain.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: two RuBP molecules two CO₂ molecules accept karein, toh kitne PGA molecules ke liye carbon available hoga?
Pehle starting aur incoming carbons ka total nikaalo, phir three-carbon groups gino.
Dekho, two RuBP ke ten carbons aur two CO₂ ke two carbons milkar twelve hote hain, isliye four three-carbon PGA molecules ka carbon account banta hai.
Isse acceptor aur first stable product ka farq clear rakho: acceptor RuBP five-carbon hai, jabki product PGA three-carbon hai.
points.screen: Do RuBP carbon groups, do incoming CO₂ carbons, aur learner ke liye khaali PGA boxes; phir twelve counters four three-carbon groups mein.
points.answer: 2 × 5 + 2 × 1 = 12 carbons; 12 ÷ 3 = 4 PGA molecules.
points.watch_out: Two CO₂ se sirf two PGA ginne par six carbons missing ho jaate hain; har RuBP acceptance se do PGA ka account banta hai.

parts.bridge: Ab acceptor aur products ka carbon hisaab mil gaya; Calvin cycle mein dekhenge ki reaction kaise chalti hai aur RuBP dobara kaise taiyaar hota hai.
parts.title: The Primary Acceptor of CO₂

parts.goal: Ab RuBP se shuru karke carbon aur energy ka poora Calvin-cycle hisaab jodenge, aur dekhenge ki sugar banne ke saath acceptor dobara kaise milta hai.

says: Ab RuBP se shuru karke carbon aur energy ka poora Calvin-cycle hisaab jodenge, aur dekhenge ki sugar banne ke saath acceptor dobara kaise milta hai.
Is process ke teen stages hain: carboxylation, reduction aur regeneration; inhe isi order mein follow karenge.
RuBP ke five carbons aur CO₂ ke one carbon se two PGA molecules ka account hum jod chuke hain.
Lekin RuBP use hota rahe, toh agle CO₂ ko kaun receive karega?
Dekho, Calvin aur co-workers ne dikhaya ki pathway RuBP ko regenerated, yaani use hone ke baad dobara taiyaar, karta hai; isi renewal se cycle close hoti hai.
Calvin pathway wahi Calvin cycle hai, jo chloroplast ke stroma mein carbon se carbohydrate banane ka kaam karta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki yeh sirf C₃ plants mein hota hai, par asal mein C₄ aur doosre photosynthetic plants bhi Calvin pathway use karte hain.
Initial fixation ka first stable product alag ho sakta hai, lekin Calvin pathway unka shared biosynthetic route hai.
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast cutaway mein stroma ka close-up; teen stage names order mein: Carboxylation → Reduction → Regeneration. Five-carbon RuBP pool aur uski taraf lautti renewal arrow; C₃ aur C₄ labels shared pathway se connected.

terms.meaning: Use hone ke baad dobara banaya gaya.
Calvin cycle ka doosra naam; photosynthetic plants ka shared carbon-assimilation pathway.

says: Ab in teen stages ke alag jobs aur unke beech carbon ka connection pehchaano.
Pehli job CO₂ ka carbon organic pathway mein laati hai, doosri fixed carbon ko carbohydrate ki direction mein badalti hai, aur teesri RuBP renew karti hai.
Carbon bahar product mein bhi jaayega aur cycle mein wapas bhi aayega; dono branches ko alag ginenge.
Energy ka sawaal kya rahega?
Dekho, har stage par note karenge ki ATP aur NADPH kahaan lagte hain, taaki carbon balance ke saath energy bill bhi clear rahe.
points.screen: Ussi realistic stromal close-up par teen numbered working regions: 1 Carboxylation, 2 Reduction, 3 Regeneration; abhi molecular arrows sirf first region tak.

says: Carboxylation mein CO₂ ka carbon RuBP se judkar stable organic intermediate, yaani aage ki reactions mein use hone wale carbon compound, mein pahunchta hai.
Ek RuBP aur ek CO₂ follow karo: RuBP ke five aur CO₂ ka one carbon milkar six-carbon total dete hain, jisse two three-carbon 3-PGA molecules bante hain.
3-PGA wahi pehle pehchaana PGA hai; iska naam 3-phosphoglyceric acid hai.
Yeh reaction RuBP carboxylase se catalysed hoti hai, yaani enzyme reaction ko tez chalne mein madad karta hai.
Is enzyme ka fuller naam RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase, ya RuBisCO, kyun hai?
Dekho, yeh CO₂ wali carboxylation ke alawa O₂ ke saath RuBP ki alag reaction bhi catalyse kar sakta hai; isi ability ko oxygenation activity kehte hain.
Abhi hum CO₂ wala route follow kar rahe hain; O₂ wali reaction ka nateeja aage dekhenge.
points.screen: Stromal picture ke first region mein RuBisCO ke paas 5C RuBP + 1C CO₂ → two 3C 3-PGA; dono phosphate tags aur carbon counts clearly visible. Enzyme name ke carboxylase aur oxygenase parts highlighted.

terms.meaning: CO₂ jodkar uske carbon ko organic compound mein incorporate karne ka step.
Pathway mein banne wala relatively stable carbon compound jo agle reactions mein use hota hai.
Pehle khole PGA ka naam: three-carbon 3-phosphoglyceric acid.
Enzyme ki madad se reaction ka tez chalna.
RuBP ki CO₂ wali carboxylation aur O₂ wali oxygenation, dono catalyse kar sakne wala enzyme.
RuBP ke saath O₂ ki alag reaction catalyse karne ki ability.

says: Ab reduction stage mein two 3-PGA molecules ko carbohydrate intermediate banne ki direction mein process karte hain.
Har 3-PGA ke liye ek ATP phosphorylation support karta hai, aur ek NADPH reducing power deta hai.
Isliye per CO₂ molecule fixed, yaani ek CO₂ jodne ke account mein, reduction ka bill two ATP aur two NADPH hai.
Is stage ka carbohydrate intermediate triose phosphate hai: triose mein tri three batata hai, isliye har molecule mein three carbons hain.
Kya ek CO₂ fix karte hi ek glucose molecule mil jaayega?
Dekho, glucose ko six carbons chahiye, isliye six CO₂ fixation aur six turns ka net carbon account ek glucose equivalent deta hai.
Turn ka matlab yahaan ek CO₂ fixation ke saath cycle ka ek accounting round hai; har round ka direct product free glucose nahi hota.
points.screen: Ussi stromal picture mein second region add ho: two 3-PGA → two triose phosphates. Har three-carbon molecule ke paas 1 ATP aur 1 NADPH input; combined reduction bill 2 ATP + 2 NADPH.

terms.meaning: Har ek CO₂ ko pathway mein incorporate karne ke hisaab se.
Three-carbon sugar phosphate jo reduction ke baad carbohydrate synthesis aur regeneration ko feed karta hai.
Cycle ke accounting rounds; har turn mein ek CO₂ fix hota hai.

points.outside_book: Reduction se milne wale triose phosphate ka carbon count aur glucose-equivalent output ko direct free-glucose production se alag kiya.

says: Ab regeneration mein carbohydrate intermediates ka ek hissa rearrange hokar RuBP pool dobara banata hai.
CO₂ acceptor wahi molecule hai jo incoming CO₂ receive karta hai; Calvin cycle mein yeh RuBP hai.
RuBP formation ki phosphorylation ke liye har fixed CO₂ ke account mein ek additional ATP chahiye.
Regeneration crucial kyun hai?
Dekho, RuBP renew na ho toh available acceptor pool ghat jaayega, aur ATP tatha NADPH hone ke bawajood next CO₂ fixation continue nahi hogi.
Renewal cycle ko uninterrupted, yaani agla round acceptor ki kami se ruke bina, chalne deta hai.
points.screen: Stromal picture mein third region add ho: triose-phosphate return branch → rearranged carbon skeletons → RuBP. Regeneration par 1 ATP per fixed CO₂ input aur ADP output.

terms.meaning: Incoming CO₂ ko receive karne wala molecule; yahaan RuBP.
Agle round ke liye zaroori supply ki kami se ruke bina.

says: Ab three CO₂ ka batch lo, taaki output aur regeneration dono ka carbon ledger poore molecules mein dikhe.
Three RuBP ke fifteen carbons aur three CO₂ ke three carbons milkar eighteen carbons dete hain: six 3-PGA molecules.
Reduction mein six ATP aur six NADPH use hokar six three-carbon triose phosphates ka pool banta hai; carbon total eighteen hi rehta hai.
Inmein one triose phosphate ka three-carbon equivalent net carbohydrate output hai, aur five triose phosphates ke fifteen carbons regeneration mein jaate hain.
Yeh fifteen carbons three five-carbon RuBP molecules ko restore karte hain, jisme three additional ATP lagte hain.
Cycle ne fifteen-carbon acceptor pool wapas banaya, toh net gain kitna hua?
Dekho, incoming three CO₂ ke three carbons ke barabar net output mila, jabki starting RuBP pool replenish ho gaya.
Six CO₂ par yahi ledger double hota hai: two net triose-phosphate equivalents ke six carbons ek glucose equivalent provide karte hain.
points.screen: Ussi stromal pathway ke beside spacious carbon ledger: 3 × 5C + 3 × 1C → 6 × 3C; phir branch 1 × 3C net output aur 5 × 3C → 3 × 5C regenerated RuBP. Quiet pathway ke sirf relevant branch par highlight.
points.outside_book: Three-CO₂ batch ka explicit carbon ledger: six triose phosphates mein se one net equivalent aur five equivalents se three RuBP regeneration.

says: Socho, workshop mein reusable mould se har batch ki shape banayi jaati hai.
Product banne ke baad mould ko clean, reassemble aur ready karne mein bhi energy lagti hai.
Manager sirf product-making electricity gine aur mould reset ka bill bhool jaaye, toh total production cost kam dikhegi.
Yahaan reusable mould RuBP ke acceptor role ko samjhata hai, product-making cost reduction ki ATP–NADPH demand hai, aur reset cost regeneration ka ATP hai.
Reset ko optional kyun nahi chhod sakte?
Dekho, agla batch ready mould maangta hai, waise hi next CO₂ fixation available RuBP maangti hai; isliye regeneration ka energy bill total mein judega.
points.screen: Workshop ke do clear cost boxes: product formation aur mould reset; saath Calvin-cycle ledger mein reduction 2 ATP + 2 NADPH aur regeneration 1 ATP.
points.outside_book: Reusable mould analogy se acceptor renewal aur separate regeneration cost samjhayi.
points.answer: Reusable mould RuBP ka acceptor role; product-making cost reduction demand; mould reset regeneration aur uska additional ATP cost.
points.watch_out: RuBP inert mould ki tarah unchanged nahi rehta; uska carbon skeleton reactions mein badalta aur intermediates se regenerate hota hai.

says: Figure 11.8 mein Atmosphere se CO₂ input follow karo; CO₂ + H₂O aur Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate stage 1, Carboxylation, se connected hain.
Clockwise arrow 3-phosphoglycerate, wahi 3-PGA, tak aur phir stage 2, Reduction, tak jaati hai.
Reduction mein ATP + NADPH enter karte hain, aur ADP + Pᵢ + NADP⁺ unke use ke baad leave karte hain.
Agla label Triose phosphate hai; downward branch Sucrose, starch ki taraf hai, jabki continuing branch regeneration ko feed karti hai.
Stage 3, Regeneration, mein ATP enter aur ADP leave karta hai, aur arrow Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate par lautkar loop close karti hai.
ATP aur NADPH photochemically made kyun kahe jaate hain?
Dekho, yeh light-driven reactions mein bante hain, isliye reduction ko light reactions ki usable energy aur reducing power milti hai.
Figure ke teen stage numbers ko jobs se jodo: carbon entry, carbohydrate intermediate formation, aur acceptor renewal.
points.screen: Ab completed stromal pathway ke saath Figure 11.8 ka uncluttered labelled map; atmospheric CO₂ + H₂O, all three stages, all carrier input–output labels, triose phosphate aur separate sucrose/starch branch sequentially highlighted.

terms.meaning: Light-driven reactions mein bana hua.
Plant ki ek sugar jisme assimilated carbon ja sakta hai.

says: Sunlit leaf ka fixed carbon sirf cycle ke andar ghoomta nahi rehta; uska net output plant ke carbohydrate pools ko feed karta hai.
Sucrose ke roop mein carbon growing parts tak transport ho sakta hai, aur starch ke roop mein temporarily store ho sakta hai.
Ek leaf apne se door growing root ko carbon material kaise de sakti hai?
Dekho, leaf-made carbohydrate transportable sugar mein convert hokar doosre tissues tak pahunch sakta hai; isi liye output branch whole-plant growth se judi hai.
points.screen: Sunlit plant par leaf se growing root aur shoot tak sucrose movement; leaf chloroplast mein starch storage ka small inset, cycle output branch se connected.
points.outside_book: Sucrose ke through assimilated carbon ka growing tissues tak transport aur leaf starch ka temporary storage role.

says: Ab ek CO₂ ka total bill jodo: reduction ke two ATP aur regeneration ka one ATP milkar three ATP hue; NADPH two hi lage.
Isliye Calvin cycle ka demand ratio three ATP to two NADPH hai.
Ab aap sochoge, ATP ki comparatively extra demand ko supply kaise milegi?
Dekho, cyclic phosphorylation wahi ATP-only cyclic photophosphorylation hai, isliye yeh extra NADPH banaye bina ATP demand poori karne mein help kar sakti hai.
Yeh unequal demand ko meet karne ka probable role hai; ek Calvin turn ke saath fixed number of cyclic electron loops nahi jodte.
points.screen: Per-CO₂ itemised ledger: reduction 2 ATP + 2 NADPH; regeneration 1 ATP; total 3 ATP + 2 NADPH. Separate PS I return loop se ATP-only supply arrow.

terms.meaning: Pehle samjhi cyclic photophosphorylation ka short reference; returning electron flow se ATP formation.

says: Ek glucose equivalent ke six carbons ke liye six CO₂ aur six turns chahiye; turn wahi ek CO₂-fixation accounting round hai.
Ab socho, phir aage badhenge: six CO₂ ke liye total ATP aur NADPH kitne lagenge?
Agar kisi ne twelve ATP aur twelve NADPH likha, toh usne kaunsa bill chhoda?
Dekho, six times three ATP se eighteen ATP aur six times two NADPH se twelve NADPH lagenge, kyunki regeneration ke six ATP bhi total mein judte hain.
Reduction ka subtotal twelve ATP aur twelve NADPH hai; regeneration six additional ATP use karti hai.
Six turns ko six glucose molecules mat samjho; unka net carbon output one glucose equivalent hai.
points.screen: Learner calculation ledger: 6 × 3 ATP = 18 ATP; 6 × 2 NADPH = 12 NADPH. Neeche ATP subtotal 12 reduction + 6 regeneration = 18.
points.answer: Six fixed CO₂ ke liye reduction mein 12 ATP aur 12 NADPH, regeneration mein 6 ATP; total 18 ATP aur 12 NADPH per glucose equivalent.
points.watch_out: 12 ATP reduction-only cost hai; regeneration ATP omit karne se total galat hota hai. One turn one glucose nahi deta.

says: Ab cycle ke inputs aur outputs ko In aur Out columns mein sort karo, taaki net production returning acceptor se alag dikhe.
Pehli row mein In six CO₂ aur Out one glucose equivalent rakho; six incoming carbons net six-carbon carbohydrate account dete hain.
Doosri row mein In eighteen ATP aur Out eighteen ADP rakho; energy use ke baad ATP carriers ADP form mein lautte hain.
Teesri row mein In twelve NADPH aur Out twelve NADP⁺ rakho; reducing electrons dene ke baad carrier oxidised form mein aata hai.
RuBP ko net consumed input mein kyun nahi rakha?
Dekho, starting acceptor pool regenerate hota hai, isliye continuous cycle ke net ledger mein uski consumption nahi dikhate.
Yeh main carbon aur carrier budget hai; phosphate aur water ka complete balanced chemical account isse alag detail rakhta hai.

Productivity of biomass ka matlab fixed time mein naya plant material banne ki rate hai.

In cells mein numerous chloroplasts, thick walls aur cells ke beech intercellular spaces ki absence khas features hain.
Intercellular spaces neighbouring cells ke beech ki khaali jagahen hain.

Dekho, sheath ke andar delivered CO₂ retain hogi, aur numerous chloroplasts ke stromal reactions us carbon ko use kar sakenge.
Chloroplast stroma ka sugar-making role hum pehle samajh chuke hain.

Pehle vascular bundle locate karo, phir uske around large chloroplast-rich sheath aur baahar mesophyll cells trace karo.
Mesophyll cells wahi leaf ke internal photosynthetic tissue ke cells hain, jinhe hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Sorghum ke section mein bhi kya isi organisation ko dhoondhoge?

Result sirf green cells dekhna nahi, balki unki organised positions pehchaanana hai.

Sirf external leaf shape ya plant ka garam jagah ugna pathway establish nahi karta; internal organisation zyada informative evidence deti hai.

In dono food crops ki leaves mein yahi microscopic organisation carbon delivery support karti hai.
Higher-temperature tolerance aur strong-light performance inki farming se jude physiological features hain.
Kya in crops ko har environment mein sabse zyada yield milegi?

says: Ab Figure 11.9 ka Hatch and Slack Pathway chaar steps mein follow karenge: initial fixation, four-carbon compound ki delivery aur CO₂ release, three-carbon return, aur acceptor renewal.

Yeh cyclic process hai, kyunki starting acceptor dobara available hota hai; acceptor renewal ka logic Calvin cycle mein bhi dekha tha.
Dono cycles ka acceptor kya same hoga?
Dekho, Calvin cycle ka acceptor RuBP tha, lekin is initial delivery cycle ka acceptor ab alag pehchaanenge.
points.screen: Realistic adjacent mesophyll aur bundle sheath cell cutaways; chaar numbered steps: fixation, delivery/release, return, renewal.

says: Mesophyll mein primary acceptor phosphoenol pyruvate, ya PEP, three-carbon molecule hai.
PEP carboxylase, ya PEPcase, initial carbon fixation catalyse karta hai, aur four-carbon OAA banta hai.
OAA wahi pehle khola oxaloacetic acid hai; carbon ledger three plus one equals four hai.
Figure mein incoming inorganic carbon HCO₃⁻, bicarbonate, ke roop mein dikhta hai; PEPcase isi form ko use karta hai.
Is typical C₄ arrangement ke mesophyll cells mein PEPcase hai, lekin RuBisCO nahi hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki C₄ ka primary acceptor four-carbon hoga, par asal mein PEP three-carbon acceptor aur OAA four-carbon product hai.
Acceptor aur enzyme ko alag kyun rakhna hai?
Dekho, PEP carbon skeleton receive karta hai, jabki PEPcase reaction catalyse karta hai; enzyme ko three-carbon acceptor kehna galat hoga.
points.screen: Wahi mesophyll cutaway: atmospheric CO₂ se HCO₃⁻, phir PEP ke three carbon beads mein one carbon add hokar OAA four beads; PEPcase label.

terms.meaning: C₄ initial fixation ka three-carbon acceptor molecule.

Bicarbonate ion; PEPcase ko milne wala inorganic carbon ka form.

Sheath mein inka breakdown CO₂ release karta hai aur three-carbon remainder deta hai; CO₂ nikalne ko decarboxylation kehte hain.

Kya return route ko free carbon recycling samajh sakte hain?

Typical C₄ accounting mein har delivered CO₂ ke liye two additional ATP equivalents lagte hain.

says: Bundle sheath mein released CO₂ ab C₃ ya Calvin pathway ko feed karti hai.
RuBisCO ke through RuBP carboxylation ka reaction hum pehle follow kar chuke hain.
Yahaan CO₂ preliminary four-carbon compound ki decarboxylation se milti hai; Calvin cycle CO₂ release nahi karti.
Calvin cycle mein fixed carbon ka net output triose phosphate sugar ke roop mein nikalta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki initial C₄ fixation hi sugar-making Calvin cycle ko replace karti hai, par asal mein yeh usse concentrated CO₂ supply karti hai.

Dekho, pehla event carbon delivery ke liye capture karta hai, aur doosra shared Calvin pathway mein carbohydrate formation ko feed karta hai.

C₃ leaves mein Calvin pathway mesophyll cells mein chalta hai, jabki typical C₄ leaf mein woh bundle sheath cells tak restricted hai.

says: Ab maize ke ek incoming carbon ko follow karo: bicarbonate ka carbon three-carbon PEP ke saath four-carbon OAA ke account mein judta hai.
Malic-acid delivery ke baad sheath mein one-carbon CO₂ release hoti hai aur three-carbon skeleton mesophyll lautkar PEP renew karta hai.
Starting three-carbon acceptor pool wapas mila; net delivered carbon kitna raha?
Dekho, ek incoming carbon Calvin cycle ko mila, jabki delivery skeleton regenerate hua; delivery loop khud extra carbon create nahi karta.
Six delivered CO₂ ke liye Calvin cycle ka pehle joda bill eighteen ATP aur twelve NADPH hai.

Yeh energy investment CO₂ concentration ke liye hai; C₄ naam ka matlab four CO₂ molecules ek saath fix hona nahi.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: four-carbon compound sheath mein CO₂ chhod de, lekin three-carbon remainder mesophyll lautna band ho jaaye, toh continuous delivery ka kya hoga?
Kya sheath mein Calvin cycle hone se missing return route apne-aap theek ho jaayega?
Dekho, return rukne par PEP acceptor pool renew nahi hoga, isliye initial capture aur sustained CO₂ delivery ghatengi, chahe sheath ki Calvin machinery present ho.
Delivery loop aur Calvin cycle alag acceptors renew karte hain; ek ki renewal doosre ki missing regeneration ko replace nahi karti.

Malic ya aspartic acid carbon sheath tak laata hai; decarboxylation one CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder deti hai.
CO₂ sheath ke RuBisCO aur Calvin cycle ko feed karti hai, jabki remainder mesophyll lautkar energy-dependent PEP renewal karta hai.
Is arrangement se growth ko fayda kyun mil sakta hai?

Dekho, CO₂ RuBisCO ke paas concentrate hoti hai aur photorespiratory loss suppress hota hai, isliye comparatively few Calvin-performing sheath cells bhi productive carbon assimilation support kar sakte hain.
Ab O₂ wali competing RuBisCO activity ka poora carbon aur energy consequence samjhenge.

parts.title: THE C₄ PATHWAY

parts.goal: Ab RuBisCO ki O₂ wali reaction ka carbon aur energy loss samjhenge, aur dekhenge ki C₄ ki concentrated CO₂ supply is loss ko kaise dabaati hai.

says: Ab RuBisCO ki O₂ wali reaction ka carbon aur energy loss samjhenge, aur dekhenge ki C₄ ki concentrated CO₂ supply is loss ko kaise dabaati hai.
Yahaan teen links follow karenge: gases ki competition, oxygenation ka carbon–energy account, aur C₄ plants ka protective CO₂ concentration.
Normal carboxylation ka pehle joda reference yaad karo: RuBP + CO₂ se RuBisCO ki madad se two 3PGA molecules bante hain.
RuBP wahi five-carbon acceptor aur 3PGA wahi three-carbon PGA hai; 2 × 3PGA ka matlab do molecules, har ek mein three carbons.
Comparison ka baseline kya hai?
Dekho, five plus one se six carbons, yaani three plus three, milte hain; ab gas badalne par isi account ko compare karenge.

terms.meaning: 3PGA ke do molecules; har molecule mein teen carbon atoms.

says: RuBisCO duniya ka most abundant enzyme hai; photosynthetic carbon fixation ki enormous demand ke liye plants mein iski bahut badi total quantity milti hai.
Itna enzyme kyun chahiye?
Dekho, bahut bade scale par carbon fixation hoti hai aur RuBisCO comparatively slow catalyst hai, isliye considerable enzyme investment chahiye.
Active site enzyme ka reaction karane wala region hai; RuBisCO ke isi catalytic region par CO₂ aur O₂ alternative reactions mein participate kar sakte hain.
Ek enzyme dono gases ke saath kaise kaam kar sakta hai?
Dekho, enzyme specificity hamesha absolute nahi hoti; RuBisCO ki catalytic chemistry RuBP ke saath dono alternative gas reactions allow karti hai.
Carboxylase-oxygenase naam wahi pehle kholi dual activity batata hai; affinity kisi molecule se judne ka jhukaav hai.
points.screen: Ussi stromal RuBisCO ka enlarged active site; RuBP present, CO₂ aur O₂ ke alternative entry arrows, dono ek saath reaction karte hue nahi.

terms.meaning: Enzyme ka region jahaan substrate ki catalysed reaction hoti hai.
Kisi molecule ke saath judne ka jhukaav.

points.outside_book: RuBisCO ki abundance samjhaane ke liye comparatively slow catalysis aur enzyme specificity ka non-absolute hona joda.

says: CO₂ aur O₂ ki concentrations comparable hon, toh RuBisCO ka jhukaav CO₂ ki taraf kaafi zyada hota hai.
Agar yeh preference na hoti, toh kya hota?
Dekho, comparable concentrations par oxygenation ko zyada opportunity milti aur productive carbon fixation ka advantage kam hota.
Binding competitive hai, yaani dono gases alternative reactions ke liye compete karti hain.
Relative concentration ka matlab ek gas ki concentration doosri ke mukaable kitni hai; CO₂:O₂ isi concentration ratio ko likhta hai.
Aksar lagta hai ki greater CO₂ affinity O₂ binding ko impossible bana degi, par asal mein reaction balance local gas concentrations par bhi depend karta hai.
CO₂ kam hone par O₂ wali reaction ka relative chance badh sakta hai.
points.screen: Same active-site view: pehle comparable gas concentrations, phir CO₂ particles kam; carboxylation aur oxygenation arrows ki relative widths badalti hain.

terms.meaning: CO₂ aur O₂ ka alternative RuBisCO reactions ke liye muqaabla.
Ek substance ki concentration doosre ke mukaable kitni hai.

says: Socho, ek service counter par do queues se candidates aa rahe hain, aur clerk ek waqt par ek candidate process karta hai.

Kya preference hone se doosri queue ki service bilkul band rahegi?
Dekho, available candidates badalne par doosri queue ko bhi zyada turns mil sakte hain.
Ab doosri queue ki arrival same rakho aur pehli queue se arrivals badha do; preferred queue ko phir zyada service opportunities milengi.
Yahaan counter RuBisCO ka active site hai, preferred queue CO₂ hai, doosri queue O₂ hai, aur arrivals unki local concentrations hain.

points.watch_out: Enzyme conscious choice nahi karta; molecular reaction probabilities affinity aur conditions se badalti hain.

says: Ab C₃ leaf mein ek five-carbon RuBP molecule ka O₂ wala reaction follow karo.
Oxygenation se one three-carbon phosphoglycerate, wahi PGA, aur one two-carbon phosphoglycolate banta hai.
Phosphoglycolate oxygenation ka two-carbon product hai, jiska processing photorespiratory route mein hota hai.
Carbon ledger yahaan five equals three plus two hai; O₂ koi naya carbon nahi laati.
Normal route se difference kya mila?
Dekho, carboxylation one external carbon jodkar two PGA deti hai, jabki oxygenation external carbon jode bina one PGA aur one phosphoglycolate deti hai.
Isliye O₂ reaction ki opportunity badhne se productive CO₂ fixation ghatati hai; isi diversion se pehle pehchaana photorespiration route shuru hota hai.
